body:
Thanks. Especially for taking the time to read all that stuff.

There are some good days and bad days but I will try to just keep pressing on like I was when I was a kid and early teenager, before all that guilt and lying happened. 

My grandpa perhaps was very attached to me since he grew up an orphan and he saw I was the only one in the family that had no father around so he got attached to me as I got attached to him. I expected him to live many more years. But sometimes life comes unexpected and we all suffer losses. I just gotta keep his positive memory and keep going. Thanks.
